verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is an SDK, CLI and hosted inference platform, not itself an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The pack documents in-SDK tool calling, an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, an OpenAPI spec and a CLI that points tools at models, but nothing shows an official MCP server or endpoint agents can connect to. Those items are adjacent building blocks and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
